cgu.title: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy of Leafline

content.details: By using the Leafline mobile application, designed to assist farmers in monitoring and managing their crops via sensors, you agree to our practices of collecting, processing, and protecting personal data as described in this document.

As part of our services, Leafline collects the following data: Non-personal agricultural data: soil moisture levels, ambient and soil temperatures, relative air humidity, sunlight levels, plant disease prediction based on algorithmic models. Personal data: geolocation of agricultural plots, email address used for application login.
Your agricultural data is processed securely and confidentially. It is used to provide personalized analyses and recommendations aimed at optimizing the management of your crops.
Technical, organizational, and legal security measures are in place to protect your data against unauthorized access, disclosure, or alteration.
Your data is retained only for the duration necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, in accordance with legal retention periods.
You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, and portability of your personal data. These rights can be exercised directly in the application or by contacting our support.
You can unsubscribe from Leafline at any time. Your data will then be securely and irreversibly deleted.
We are committed to maintaining transparent communication regarding our practices of collecting, processing, and protecting your personal data.
We reserve the right to modify our privacy policy. You will be informed of any significant changes.
By checking the box below, you agree to the terms of these terms of use, including the collection and processing of your agricultural and personal data as specified.
